jetbrains.adoptfolder.is-at-the-root-smi: {manifest} is at the root. smith manages one folder per project and does not pick it for you. Move it into a folder of its own so smith can manage it?
jetbrains.adoptfolder.add-a-gitattribute: Add a .gitattributes with * text=auto eol=lf, so every machine writes the same line endings? A repository that has one keeps it.
jetbrains.adoptfolder.add-the-monosmith-: Add the MonoSmith agent files, so Claude Code can work in this workspace through smith?
jetbrains.adoptfolder.you-can-add-them-l: You can add them later with smith agent install.
jetbrains.adoptfolder.smith-writes-no-pi: smith writes no pipeline for that provider.
jetbrains.adoptfolder.smith-writes-its-o: smith writes its own; yours is kept as <file>.pre-smith.
jetbrains.adoptfolder.nothing-was-change: Nothing was changed yet. This is the plan with its diffs. smith writes smith.toml and the pipelines.
jetbrains.adoptfolder.the-folder-is-a-mo: The folder is a MonoSmith workspace
jetbrains.adoptfolder.the-first-answer-i: {header} The first answer is the default.
jetbrains.adoptfolder.the-folder-from-th: The folder, from the repository root (for example tools/{name}):
jetbrains.adoptfolder.tick-none-to-write: {prompt} Tick none to write no pipeline. The default is ticked.
jetbrains.adoptfolder.the-project-stays-: The project stays at the root; smith cannot manage it there.
jetbrains.adoptfolder.must-be-lowercase-: "{name}" must be lowercase letters and digits with words joined by single hyphens, starting with a letter (for example web-app).
jetbrains.adoptfolder.is-not-a-folder-sm: "{folder}" is not a folder smith can move the project into: {why}.
jetbrains.adoptfolder.it-is-the-reposito: it is the repository root, where the project is already
jetbrains.adoptfolder.it-must-be-relativ: it must be relative to the repository root
jetbrains.adoptfolder.a-folder-that-star: a folder that starts with a dot is for tools
jetbrains.adoptfolder.use-letters-digits: use letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore
